title: Issue update requires token write access
root_cause: The workflow token has issues read permission but the request updates an issue. GitHub rejects the PATCH with 403 and identifies issues write as the required permission.

relevant_evidence.why: The response is 403 and names the required permission.
The response body reports that the integration cannot access the resource.
The token is limited to issues read.
The step uses that token for the issue update.
